g.text: Offline ELF metadata — bounded program/dynamic metadata, no loader or reader
v1 input<=1MiB; no unsafe backing memory
Limits accept own data only and may tighten only
Convert file offsets after BigInt bounds checks
At most one PT_INTERP and one PT_DYNAMIC
Declared-slot cap includes unused tail slots
One entire file-backed PT_LOAD mapping only
Reject aliases, split spans and BSS-only data
Table<=64KiB; dynamic string<=1024 bytes with NUL
Keep NEEDED order/duplicates and raw RPATH/RUNPATH
No path joins, search, expansion or dereference
v1 JSON<=64KiB; digest is not provenance
No candidate or SDK archive read by this module
No symbol, CPU, provenance or enforcement proof
validate native view, backing and cap before copy
private bytes only; all U64 arithmetic in BigInt
validated spans and bounded declared slot count
unique string table; offsets stay inside captured bytes
bounded declarations, not actual symbol/CPU proof
immutable plain data; no input-backed views
unsupported format, overflow or malformed span
duplicate singleton, missing DT_NULL or ambiguous mapping
missing bounded NUL, invalid UTF-8/control or output overrun
bad chains, overlaps, notes or property bounds
throw fixed failure; no partial-success metadata
Synthetic tests establish only this supported metadata subset, not actual candidate compatibility.
Interpreter/library strings remain untrusted data and never become host-file allowances.
v1 unknown tags remain opaque; v2 decodes bounded version and GNU-note declarations only.
No relocations, actual symbol resolution, CPU detection or loader execution occurs.
Source caps do not establish native heap, CPU, runtime-closure or F9/game authority.
Source/version/provenance, real ELF dependency closure and decoder execution remain separate gates.
